summary: refactor(settings): address review feedback on passkey wrap opt-in
description:
Because:
* Review asked for the wrap staleness test to live in one place.
* Branch rules were reachable only through the full sign-in hook, so each
  case cost a renderHook and a set of auth-client mocks.

This commit:
* Pushes wrap staleness into the delete predicate as `staleBefore`.
* Extracts the kB stash, envelope store and offer rule as named helpers
  with direct unit tests.
* Names the initial and retry store errors in the wrap creation path.
* Builds auth-client test rejections as errno-bearing `Error`s.
* Tightens held-material assertions and drops redundant hook tests.
